subject: Request: rollover unused cohort credits to pilot
messages:
From: Sofia Patel <sofia@launchbridge.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: rollover unused cohort credits to pilot

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re doing well — LaunchBridge wrapped cohort 6 last week and we have ~28k unused Redwood promo credits in the cohort pool. Our portfolio company, VoxelFarm, is running a 6-week paid pilot with us starting June 9 and asked whether those unused cohort credits can be rolled over or applied to the pilot.

Quick context:
- Cohort credit grant: 100k total per cohort, VoxelFarm used ~72k.
- Pilot expected consumption: ~40–60k tokens over 6 weeks (mostly gen-heavy).

Two questions:
1) Is one-off portability/rollover something Redwood will make for accelerator programs?
2) If not, can we convert credits to a deep pilot discount instead?

I attached the cohort SOW and a usage export for your reference (SOW_v1.pdf, accelerator_usage_report.csv).

We’d like to finalize before the pilot kickoff so the startup has clarity for expenses. Appreciate any process notes and whether this needs legal/finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Sofia Patel
Program Manager | LaunchBridge Accelerator
sofia@launchbridge.org

---
Attachment: SOW_v1.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
Attachment: accelerator_usage_report.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Patel <sofia@launchbridge.org>
Date: Tue, 27 May 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: rollover unused cohort credits to pilot

Hi Sofia — great to hear from you and congrats on wrapping cohort 6.

Short answer: we don’t have a standard cross-account rollover flow, but we can treat this as a partner exception if it’s scoped and approved internally. Two pragmatic options to get VoxelFarm predictable costs before kickoff:

Option A — Credit portability (one-off exception):
- We can apply up to 40% of the unused cohort credits to the named pilot account as a consumed-credit transfer.
- Requires finance & partnerships approval and a signed addendum.

Option B — Pilot deep discount:
- Convert the unused cohort credits to a time-limited discount for the pilot (example: 30% off for first 60k tokens).
- Faster to approve; no addendum required but discount applies only to the first invoice cycle.

Questions for you:
- Do you need the credit to be tied to VoxelFarm’s Redwood account or can it be a billing rebate applied to the pilot invoice?
- Does LaunchBridge need a formal addendum on letterhead?
- Is there an internal deadline we should hit to flip this before June 9?

I’ll loop in Finance/Partnerships to evaluate the portability ask if you prefer Option A.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

---
Referenced attachments: accelerator_usage_report.csv

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: LaunchBridge — cohort credit portability request (needs approval)

Team — forwarding LaunchBridge request (see original below). Key ask: apply up to 28k unused cohort credits to a named pilot account (VoxelFarm) starting June 9.

Why I’m asking:
- This is a partner-driven pilot that often converts to paid post-pilot; accelerator is asking for portability to avoid founder churn.
- If we decline outright, risk: partner dissatisfaction and potential lost conversion.

Proposed compromise (pick one):
1) Approve one-time portability of 40% of unused cohort credits (~28k): require signed addendum, cap usable tokens per month at 25k, credits expire after 8 weeks.
2) Approve billing rebate/discount: 30% off first 60k tokens billed to VoxelFarm; no addendum needed — Finance can apply as credit memo.

If we go with #1 we need Partnerships to draft a simple addendum (I can coordinate) and Finance sign-off on token accounting. Please reply with: OK to proceed / prefer #2 / decline.

Thanks,
Mina

---
Attachment (forwarded): SOW_v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: LaunchBridge — cohort credit portability request (needs approval)

Mina — I’m OK with a constrained portability approval with conditions. My suggested guardrails:
- Approve portability up to 40% of unused cohort credits (max 30k).
- Require a signed addendum (one page) that:
  - Names VoxelFarm Redwood account id,
  - Caps monthly token consumption to 25k while the credits are active,
  - Specifies expiration (8 weeks from first applied date).
- Require Partnerships to attach the approved addendum to the HubSpot deal and mark deal_id ACC-2025-0412.

Finance will perform a journal entry for transferred credits (reduce cohort liability, create pilot credit memo). I’ll coordinate with Lauren on the ledger side.

Ben Carter
Head, Partnerships & Alliances | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

---
Note: conditional approval — if LaunchBridge insists on unrestricted transfer, we decline and offer Option B (discount).

From: Sofia Patel <sofia@launchbridge.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: LaunchBridge Ops <ops@launchbridge.org>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: rollover unused cohort credits to pilot — accepted terms

Thanks Mina & Ben — LaunchBridge accepts the conditional portability path. We’ll sign the one-page addendum and send it back today. Confirmation:
- Transfer requested: 28,000 credits applied to VoxelFarm account ID VF-9981.
- Monthly cap: 25k tokens.
- Expiration: 8 weeks from activation.
- DocuSign link (addendum) attached and signed: addendum_signed.pdf.

We appreciate the flexibility — this helps VoxelFarm close the pilot plan. Please advise once the credit memo entry is complete and the credits are visible on Voxelfarm’s billing portal.

Best,
Sofia Patel
Program Manager | LaunchBridge Accelerator
sofia@launchbridge.org
